string LtoR(string s, int L, int R) {
    string t = s;
    char tmp = t[L];
    for (int i = L; i < R; ++i)
        t[i] = t[i + 1];
    t[R] = tmp;
    return t;
}

string RtoL(string s, int L, int R) {
    string t = s;
    char tmp = t[R];
    for (int i = R; i > L; --i)
